answer: As the dawn breaks across the ocean, decentralized validator nodes must not wander from their assigned zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions. We define a cryptoeconomic mechanism where an adversary multiplying identities faces a dynamic opportunity-cost bond B and a subgame-perfect slashing penalty S. Because the expected utility of identity multiplication U = p(B - S) - (1-p)B is strictly negative for all positive detection probabilities, the honest strategy profile converges to a unique, robust Nash equilibrium.
